facts.text: I'm a kid's dad now, and I'm making this up as I go. Pass the cereal.
facts.why: Invented line signed Sonny Koufax. In the film he says things like 'Dented cans are half-price. Microsoft went down 3 points. We gotta save some money.' while shopping with Julian.
facts.fix: Dented cans are half price. Microsoft went down three points. We gotta save some money.

fix_note.text: Dented cans are half price. Microsoft went down three points. We gotta save some money.

facts.text: Julian and Sonny. Signed in a hurry.
facts.why: The fortune slip is headed 'Adoption Papers'. In the film Sonny never signs adoption papers. He keeps Julian until a family is found, then fights for custody in court, and Kevin ends up with Julian. Nothing I opened mentions hurried signing.
facts.fix: Custody Papers. Julian and Sonny. Fought for in court.

facts.text: Julian's order. Sonny lets him pick everything.
facts.why: In the McDonald's scene Julian asks for Cheerios and then lasagna. No source mentions a banana smoothie. 'Sonny lets him pick everything' is true to the film.
facts.fix: Julian wanted lasagna. Sonny lets him pick everything.

vibe.verdict: Good takeaway look and the delivery-guy world fits, but the food is mostly guesswork and the McDonald's, Yoohoo and Cozy's moments are missing.
missing: Yoohoo at the school playground (Sonny and the kids)
McDonald's stops breakfast at 10:30 and Julian asks for Cheerios then lasagna (breakfast scene)
Cozy's delivery guy Nazo and his chocolate cake (the apartment)
Dented SpaghettiOs cans, 'Microsoft went down three points' (grocery aisle)
Curly fries at the Hooters party (Vanessa the waitress)
Scuba Steve keeping his flippers on, even bowling (the couch chat)
ideas: Swap 'Banana smoothie' for 'Yoohoo, hold the rum' (the playground scene).
Swap the cheeseburger note for 'McDonald's hotcakes, 30 minutes and 4 seconds too late.'
Swap 'Central Park everything bagel bites' for 'Cozy's chocolate cake, hand delivered by Nazo.'
Swap the note for Sonny's real dented cans line.
